output.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS discounted_orders
FROM marts.fct_orders
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND discount_amount > 0;
output.explanation: Counts every order placed in 2025, whatever its status (completed, cancelled, returned or open), where discount_amount is greater than zero. A discount on any line makes discount_amount positive, so this catches every order with at least one discounted line. No revenue filter is applied because you asked about all statuses.
